text: Security is an essential part of web development. When you build a website, you must protect both your users and your data. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt the connection between the browser and the server. Second, implement strong authentication so that only the right people can access accounts. Third, validate all input from users, because this helps prevent common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS). Many attacks happen simply because developers trust user data. By following these basic practices, you can make your website much safer and reduce the risk of serious security problems.
